title: Instrument shuttle transfer
task: Move a loaded test shuttle to the outgoing bay with both arms while keeping the loose calibration cassette registered.
planner: Shared minimum-jerk Cartesian path, time-law search under speed and traction constraints, and damped Jacobian inverse kinematics for both seven-joint arms.
criterion: The loose cassette center shifts at least 15 mm from its carriage reference mark.
detail_target: Shuttle reference marks and calibration cassette

steps.text: Lower both push tools behind the two carriage lugs.
Advance to the lugs together to distribute the pushing force.
Execute the shared 1.52 s transport profile.
Lift both tools clear of the carriage and check the cassette registration.

safe.summary: Plan within the cassette traction envelope.
safe.caption: The cassette stays aligned with the two carriage marks.

steps.text: Lower both push tools behind the two carriage lugs.
Advance to the lugs together to distribute the pushing force.
Execute the shared 0.72 s transport profile.
Lift both tools clear of the carriage and check the cassette registration.

unsafe.summary: Use the shortest transfer allowed by the robot speed bound.
unsafe.caption: The cassette shifts relative to the moving carriage.

audit.model_source: robosuite Baxter, its Rethink parallel grippers and its Rethink pedestal. The shuttle push shoes and optical reader are application tooling.
audit.controller: Inverse-dynamics feed-forward, joint position and velocity feedback with the source motors’ torque bounds. Physical contacts advance the carriage, cassette, spring button and flag.

revision_actions: Retain the synchronized dual-arm push transport and carriage retract profile.
Execute a coordinated asymmetric high unloaded park confirmation pose within 12 mm during the final hold and return both arms to their recorded park poses.
